name: 76119 · Fort Worth, TX
findings: ZIP 76119 (Fort Worth) has 139 nonprofit organizations. 50 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (57% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 76119 (Fort Worth) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
